en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a broad open green field bordered by a wooden fence and bare trees in the foreground, with a row of early 20th‑century town buildings in the background. The architecture includes multi‑storey houses with gabled roofs and decorative facades, set against a forested hillside. Printed caption text appears at the lower left.
